name: Mr. Joshua

origin.summary: Honors Navy Special Warfare Operator 1st Class Joshua Thomas Harris, 36, a SEAL who drowned during combat operations on August 30, 2008. Runs, GHD sit-ups, and heavy deadlifts — midline endurance stacked against a heavy hinge, five times.

description: Five rounds of a 400m run, GHD sit-ups, and heavy deadlifts.
source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/mr-joshua (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09
